name: Neos Fusion
effectText: Send from your hand, Deck, or field to the GY, the Fusion Materials that are mentioned on a Fusion Monster that mentions exactly 2 monsters as material, including "Elemental HERO Neos", then Special Summon that Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions. You cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn after this card resolves. If a Fusion Monster(s) you control that mentions "Elemental HERO Neos" as material would be destroyed by battle or card effect, or shuffled into the Extra Deck by its own effect, you can banish this card from your GY instead.
